Maya CSM: Heads-up — FjordCare renewal due Fri. Customer requests 11-month term (starts Apr 1) and immediate seat increase of 3. PO inbound but procurement says they need our vendor code and a signed SOW annex. Also signer used a personal alias so e-sign failed. Can we prioritize?
Leo AM: I'll chase procurement for vendor code and ask for a PDF of the PO. Do we allow alias if they provide ID?
Sam Legal: We prefer corporate email. If alias is only contact, we accept a delegated-authority letter + ID copy. I'll prepare a short template.
Priya Finance: For proration we need exact seat count effective date + vendor code. If PO arrives after renewal date we'll issue an amendment and a credit note. Net terms? Customer asked Net45.
Maya CSM: Customer confirmed Net45 is fine. Action: Leo to upload PO to ticket and confirm signer email; Sam will DM the delegated-authority template; Priya to pre-run proration calc.
Leo AM: PO uploaded to Zendesk (PO# FC-77881). Procurement replied: vendor code FC-5566. Attaching here. Also got alt signer: maria@fjordcare.co (corporate).
docusign-bot: ERROR: recipient email domain mismatch with stored contact. Suggest resending to corporate address or enable ID verification.
Maya CSM: Resending envelope to maria@fjordcare.co now.
docusign-bot: SENT: Envelope ID e8c12d to maria@fjordcare.co (ID verification optional).
Leo AM: Maria confirmed she will sign today and procurement accepted vendor code FC-5566.
Onboarding Bot: Note: onboarding kickoff scheduled Apr 8 — marked tentative until contract fully executed.
Sam Legal: Delegated-authority template ready as DM. If Docusign still errors, request a scanned letter on company letterhead.
Priya Finance: Proration stub: annual fee $84,000 -> monthly $7,000. 11 months = $77,000. Seat add 3 x $1,500/mo -> prorated = $49,500 for 11 months? Wait I'll post final calc to ticket after verifying seat price.
Maya CSM: Thanks all — I'll confirm when envelope completes. If anything slips we switch to amendment path. :thumbsup:
